claimBoundary: Findings are same-circuit E2 engineering observations reproduced against repository code. Resolved means repository-level falsifiers and CI contracts exist; it does not mean independent penetration testing or deployment assurance.

findings.title: AI SSRF address-classification gaps
findings.exploitCondition: AI hostname resolves to IPv4-mapped hex IPv6 or selected reserved/documentation transition ranges not rejected by the previous classifier.

findings.title: Unbounded AI provider response buffering
findings.exploitCondition: A reachable provider streams or declares an oversized body and the pinned transport accumulates it in memory.

findings.title: Recovery attachment namespace laundering
findings.exploitCondition: Snapshot metadata declares an attachment clean while bytes exist only in quarantine; previous recovery lookup searched both namespaces and could restore the bytes under the clean logical path.

findings.title: Attachment serving lacked mandatory byte digest/size verification
findings.exploitCondition: Physical attachment bytes are modified after metadata creation while trust metadata remains clean.

findings.title: Tenant routing identity could diverge from authorized actor identity
findings.exploitCondition: Tenant routing and Shibboleth/RBAC consume different configured subject/group headers, or legacy actor header differs from routing subject.

findings.title: Malformed or encoded-separator route parameters were not fail-closed
findings.exploitCondition: Dynamic route segment contains malformed percent encoding or decodes to slash/backslash/NUL.

findings.title: Scanner attestation not tenant-bound
findings.exploitCondition: Same attachment id/digest appears in another tenant and an otherwise valid scanner attestation is replayed.

findings.title: Legacy clean trust could bypass new tenant binding
findings.exploitCondition: A pre-tenant scan-clean trust record is reused in multi-tenant mode without re-attestation.

findings.title: CSV spreadsheet formula injection
findings.exploitCondition: User-controlled label/narrative begins with =,+,-,@ after optional control/whitespace and an operator opens current-view CSV in spreadsheet software.

findings.title: Generic evidence resolution lost tenant context for attachment trust
findings.exploitCondition: A generic evidence consumer evaluates tenant-bound attachment trust without a request tenant context, causing either false denial of correct trust or unsafe acceptance if the predicate is loosened.

externalResiduals: approved disaster-recovery objectives and off-host drill
